metadata.case_name: FRANCINE LOUISE COLLINS v. THE STAR FERRY CO. LTD.

injuries.description: post traumatic stress disorder ("PTSD") which was chronic.
source: post traumatic stress disorder ("PTSD") which was chronic.

injuries.description: contusion injury over the left side of her head, neck, left shoulder and arm; musculo-skeletal injury assessed at 3% impairment of the whole person.
injuries.body_part: left side of head, neck, left shoulder and arm
source: she had suffered from severe contusion injury over the left side of her head, neck, left shoulder and arm.
I prefer the assessment of Dr Chang and find the musculo-skeletal injury to be 3% impairment of the whole person.
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of other or unspecified sites of head

manifestations.description: nightmares of the accident and of violent events
distress and palpitations when seeing someone watching her or when something rushes by
recurrent distressing recollections of the accident (six to eight times a day)
avoidance of the Star Ferry and distress when exposed to the site of the accident
diminished interest in activities and in socializing
less capable of warmth in her feelings for husband and son; relational / marital strain
difficulty in sleeping, thinking and concentrating
depressive and labile mood with lack of self-esteem; irritability with outbursts of anger
headache which lasted four to five days at a time
weakness of left arm (unable to lift up baby or perform household work)
numbness and tingling sensation over left forearm and all fingers
ache in left upper arm where tyre struck and in upper part of forearm; local painful spot over left arm
pain in neck on rotating it and on touch; neck muscle spasm and tenderness; reduced range of motion of the cervical spine
limited mouth opening (TM joint pain / restricted opening)

treatments_future: physiotherapy (twice a month for 7 years as assessed)
acupuncture (twice a month for 7 years as assessed)

losses.description: Unable to return to her accounting work; loss of prospect of resuming previous accountant employment

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Unable to participate in tennis, golf and hiking which she used to enjoy
Handicapped in playing role as spouse and mother; impaired relationship with husband and children; general family strain

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: Lack of libido; diminished sexual interest

losses.category: Loss of confidence in going out in the public
losses.description: Avoidance of Star Ferry, distress in crowds and panic reactions when objects rush by

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Unable to lift baby or perform household work because of left upper limb weakness
Diminished interest in socialising and limited social and recreational activities
post traumatic stress disorder ("PTSD") which was chronic.
